reask.en: Put the tester turned on the top corner of a square kite flying slanting: will the corner be less open, an exact fit, or more open?

did.hi: tirchi udti patang ke kone par tester ka faisla kiya

viewCaption.hi: Board par wahi square patang do baar hai: pehli seedhi, doosri hawa mein ghoom kar tirchi.

why.hi: patang square hai, toh tirchi udne par bhi uska har kona right angle hai; ghuma kar rakha tester bilkul fit hoga

whyShort.hi: tirchi patang ka har kona bhi right angle hai

whyAlt.hi: hawa mein tirchi hone se kona patla dikh sakta hai, par patang wahi square hai; kona dikhne se nahi, tester se jaancho

simpler.hi: Patang ek square hai, bas tirchi ud rahi hai. Yaad karo, ghumane se square ke kone par kya asar hota hai.
simpler.en: The kite is a square, just flying slanting. Remember what turning does to a square's corners.

pictureCaption.hi: Yahan tester tirchi patang ke kone par seedha rakha hai, isliye uske seedhe kinaare patang ki bhujaon ke saath nahi padte. Ise patang ke saath ghumana hoga.

why.hi: photo mein wahi darwaza sirf tircha chhapa hai, aur tircha hone se kone nahi badalte, toh uske kone right angle hain

prompt.hi: 12 cm ki string ghumate waqt beech mein dheeli ho gayi. Kya bani hui gol shape circle hai?
prompt.en: A 12 cm string went slack partway while going round. Is the round shape that was drawn a circle?

reask.hi: 12 cm string beech mein dheeli ho jaane se bani gol shape kya circle hai?
reask.en: Is the round shape drawn when a 12 cm string went slack partway a circle?

accept: no, it is not a circle

viewCaption.hi: Ab centre se do teer hain: ek kinaare tak poore 12 cm ka, aur ek dheeli string wali jagah tak. Dono ki lambai milao.
viewCaption.en: Now there are two arrows from the centre: one to the edge, a full 12 cm, and one to the place where the string went slack. Compare their lengths.

why.hi: string beech mein dheeli hui, toh har point 12 cm door nahi raha: shape gol dikhti hai, par circle nahi
why.en: the string went slack midway, so not every point stayed 12 cm away: it looks round, but is not a circle

whyShort.hi: dheeli string se doori 12 cm nahi rahi
whyShort.en: a slack string did not keep 12 cm

whyAlt.hi: dheeli string se pencil centre ke paas aa jaati hai, 12 cm se kam par; circle mein woh har jagah poore 12 cm par rehti hai
whyAlt.en: a slack string lets the pencil come nearer the centre, less than 12 cm; in a circle it stays a full 12 cm everywhere

simpler.hi: Circle mein har point centre se string jitna door hota hai. Socho, dheeli string se yeh doori har jagah wahi rahegi kya.
simpler.en: In a circle every point is one string-length from the centre. Think whether a slack string keeps that distance the same everywhere.

answerViewCaption.hi: Dheeli string wali jagah par kinaara centre ke paas aa gaya, 12 cm se kam par; doori har jagah 12 cm nahi rahi.
answerViewCaption.en: Where the string went slack, the edge came nearer the centre, less than 12 cm; the distance was not 12 cm everywhere.

prompt.hi: Square tile, har bhuja 30 cm, tirchi rakhi hai. Tester tile ke saath ghuma kar kone par rakho: kona kam khula hoga, bilkul fit, ya zyada khula?
prompt.en: A square tile, each side 30 cm, lies slanting. Put the tester on a corner, turned with the tile: will the corner be less open, exactly fit, or more open?

did.hi: ghumayi hui, lambi bhuja wali square tile ka kona tester se jaancha
did.en: tested the corner of a turned square tile with long sides

why.hi: tile square hai, toh uska har kona right angle hai; ghumane se kona nahi badalta, aur 30 cm lambi bhuja se kona zyada nahi khulta, isliye tester bilkul fit hoga
why.en: the tile is a square, so each corner is a right angle; turning does not change a corner, and 30 cm sides do not widen it, so the tester fits

simpler.hi: Do baatein ek-ek karke socho: tile ko ghumane se uska kona badla kya, aur lambi bhuja se kona zyada khula kya.
simpler.en: Think about two things one at a time: did turning the tile change its corner, and did the long sides open the corner wider.

reask.en: A square tile with 30 cm sides lies slanting. How will the turned tester sit in its corner: less open, an exact fit, or more open?

covered.hi: Aaj dekha ki right angle kitaab ke kone jaisa hai, aur ghumane se nahi badalta. Phir angle khulne se parkhe, aur circle dekha: uska har point centre se barabar door.
covered.en: Today: a right angle is like a book's corner, and turning does not change it. We judged angles by opening, and met the circle: all equally far from the centre.
